warning.title: WARNING: while you are escalated, your statements and their values are logged in clear text
statements: pgaudit does not record an escalated session's reads and writes.
While escalated, the server writes every statement you run to its log, and it writes the values you bind to a statement's parameters there too, in clear text.
This happens whatever the cluster's audit settings say: logParameters: false does not stop it.
If you are using emergency access as part of an audit, your auditors will be able to read every value you used.
warning.record: These are the requests that exist now. A request that was deleted leaves nothing here. The server log, and the Kubernetes API server's audit log if you keep one, hold the rest of the record.
